# MERIT SCHOLARSHIP STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE

## 1. PURPOSE AND SCOPE
This standard operating procedure governs the submission, evaluation, and disbursement of merit scholarships for undergraduate students across all engineering and science departments.

## 2. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
Eligible students who maintain a minimum cumulative grade point average of 8.5 on a 10-point scale may submit an application. Applicants must submit official grade transcripts and family income statements.

## 3. APPLICATION DEADLINE
All scholarship applications must be submitted before 31 March of each academic year to the department portal. Late submissions shall not be entertained under normal intake cycles.

## 4. INTAKE AND VERIFICATION
The scholarship applicant completes the online application form and attaches certified mark sheets. The form is verified. After initial screening, the scholarship clerk cross-checks student income certificates against the national tax database.

## 5. EXTENDED SUBMISSION TIMEFRAME
Notwithstanding Section 3, complete renewal dossiers and supporting affidavits must be submitted before 15 April of each academic year. Submissions received after this date require dean approval.

## 6. DEPARTMENT REVIEW AND REPEATED VERIFICATION
The scholarship clerk cross-checks student income certificates against the national tax database. The department scholarship committee reviews verified candidate dossiers and selects qualified recipients based on academic merit.

## 7. FINAL DISBURSEMENT
The finance officer transfers approved scholarship stipends directly into the recipient student bank account within thirty calendar days of committee approval.
